```artifact
Feature: Controller Performance and Functionality

  Scenario Outline: Controller should respond fast enough to prevent pressure dropping below -4cm
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the pressure drops below -4cm
    Then the controller should respond within <response_time> ms
    Examples:
      | response_time |
      | 100           |
      | 200           |
      | 300           |

  Scenario Outline: Controller should never command pressure to go above 60
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the commanded pressure is set to <commanded_pressure>
    Then the actual pressure should not exceed 60
    Examples:
      | commanded_pressure |
      | 55                |
      | 60                |
      | 65                |

  Scenario Outline: SW must measure PEEP over each breath
    Given the controller is initialized
    When a breath cycle is completed
    Then the PEEP value should be recorded
    Examples:
      | breath_cycle |
      | 1            |
      | 2            |
      | 3            |

  Scenario Outline: Controller should hit commanded values within 10%
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the commanded value is <commanded_value>
    Then the actual value should be within 10% of <commanded_value>
    Examples:
      | commanded_value | actual_value |
      | 10              | 11           |
      | 20              | 22           |
      | 30              | 33           |

  Scenario Outline: Controller should trigger an inspiration cycle when
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the inspiration trigger condition is met
    Then the controller should trigger an inspiration cycle
    Examples:
      | trigger_condition |
      | tidal_volume      |
      | respiratory_rate  |

  Scenario Outline: Controller should trigger an expiration cycle when
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the expiration trigger condition is met
    Then the controller should trigger an expiration cycle
    Examples:
      | trigger_condition |
      | tidal_volume      |
      | respiratory_rate  |

  Scenario Outline: Controller should be able to meet PIP targets in the range 5-55cmH2O +/- 5cm
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the commanded PIP is <commanded_PIP>
    Then the actual PIP should be within +/- 5cm of <commanded_PIP>
    Examples:
      | commanded_PIP | actual_PIP |
      | 10            | 15         |
      | 25            | 30         |
      | 40            | 45         |

  Scenario Outline: Controller should be able to meet commanded breath rate within +- 1 breath
    Given the controller is initialized
    When the commanded breath rate is <commanded_rate>
    Then the actual breath rate should be within +- 1 breath of <commanded_rate>
    Examples:
      | commanded_rate | actual_rate |
      | 10             | 11          |
      | 20             | 21          |
      | 30             | 31          |
```
